text:
Leah: Quick company note: leadership approved a Spring Reset — two separate 4-hour paid wellness pauses for all employees on payroll (use within 60 days). Think of them as short windows to step away, handle caregiving, or recharge. Not bankable after the window closes.
Carlos: Nice. Are those available to part-time employees too?
Leah: Yes — prorated for part-time regulars (not gig/contractors). Contractors will receive a $100 wellbeing credit in the vendor portal instead.
Nina: Will this appear on my time-off balance or as a separate line?
Leah: It will show as a separate ad-hoc credit in the time-off system (internal view only). Payroll/tax docs unaffected.
Ben: Any limits around launches or team-wide blackouts? We have a release in two weeks.
Leah: No mandated blackout. Please coordinate with your manager — teams with critical launches should post coverage plans to #eng-release. If you need an exception for the pause window, message People Ops.
Harper: Travel question: I'm speaking at a conference during the reset period. Can I use one of the pauses while traveling?
TravelBot: TravelBot: Conference/training days are eligible for use. Reminder: all business travel still requires a Travel Authorization (TA) submission and approval before booking. New updates to TA: travelers must indicate whether they want a carbon-offset option for flights (opt-in checkbox) and acknowledge local contact info. TA link: https://intranet.redwood.com/forms/travel-auth
Nina: Any documentation to avoid delays for international travel approvals?
TravelBot: Checklist: 
- Passport copy uploaded to TA form
- Emergency contact listed in HR profile
- Laptop encryption verified and KMS access confirmed
- Local contact / sponsor name and phone
- COVID/vaccine docs if required by destination
SLA: Standard TA reviews within 48 hours; use escalate on the form for expedited processing.
Carlos: Will the wellbeing credit for contractors be paid out or in vouchers?
Leah: It'll be an account credit in the vendor portal usable against wellness services booked through our vendor catalog. Not cashable.
Ben: Can managers block the resets on team calendars?
Leah: Managers can coordinate scheduling but cannot universally opt teams out. If a team truly needs a blackout, submit a short justification and People Ops will review.
Harper: Any connection to the code-of-conduct or training requirements?
Leah: Were also pushing a short 6-minute Respect at Redwood micro-course this quarter. Completion is strongly encouraged for everyone — managers get reminders when their team completes it. Not punitive, just a refresh.
Nina: Will this show up in the benefits page?
Leah: Added now: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/spring-reset — includes manager FAQ, contractor credit FAQ, and travel checklist.
TravelBot: Reminder: expense policy updated — receipts for carbon-offset purchases must be attached to the expense report for reimbursement.
Carlos: If I'm on unpaid leave during the 60-day window, am I eligible?
Leah: Employees must be on payroll (active) at the time of the credit to receive it. For edge cases returning from LOA during the window, DM People Ops and we'll evaluate on a case-by-case basis.
Ben: Thanks — can you post a short company-wide email?
Leah: Yes, will send all-company note at 9:30am PT with links. Closing thread — DM me for exceptions or special cases. :white_check_mark:
